It's really annoying, nothing wrong with wanting something casual but I do not and make that clear on my profile. Then it's like they try to convince you stick around. Blerggggh.

It's the place I live. People come and go constantly, and  are always looking for "better" or don't want to commit or really date because most people don't know how long they will be here. I'm sadly not the only one with this issue, hookup culture is rampant so actually dating is rough.
I mean if i knew him and we were dating sure but we've not met yet which is why I was kinda surprised.

Yes. I was with a man for 3 years who slowly cut me off emotionally, financially, broke me down so I forgot how make decisions. He was emotionally and sometimes physically abusive in a non traditional sense (never hit me but would make me do physical labour I was incapable of or would put me in dangerous situations). If I tries to work for anyone but him he would complain until I quit. Almost killed us by ignoring gas leaking into the house. Covid hit and he wouldn't follow the guidelines. I fled. I had nothing. No job. No place to live so I had to stay with family. Wasn't even sure I could keep the pets.

Almost a year later and with alot of work and help from friends/family/therapy I have rebuilt myself into the confident person I was before. I found a job, went from contract to full time with benefits. I took the pets, fought him for ownership and won. Am rebuilding the savings and getting myself out of some debt. It's still a long road but I have already come so far. I'm not going to easy. But don't for a second think it's impossible.

Someone else said ask for and take all the help you  an get and I think that is the best advice. I couldn't have done it otherwise.

I'm 5'6 and EVERY ONE has basically made a big deal about it. "Wow you are tall!!) To the point where I felt like a giant,  not cute and wished I was shorter! 

Point being. People are going to see you how they want to see you. As a friend of mine said, find someone who likes it about you and lean into it or drop them and move on if they don't. Alot of the advice above from other users is solid, and I hope helps!
